description: Runs one finished relay run (done, failed or dead — its id from relay_runs) again, every action of the relay as it is now; an action that already succeeded finds its own earlier work (a payment's grants are given once, an email isn't sent twice), while an address a call_url action calls is called again. In Development it runs at once. In Live (env live) it asks the founder to approve it in their browser — the page says what the relay does, including that it moves money or calls an address — and approving it runs it, once (live_action_status with wait: true reads the outcome). A run that is still queued or running, or an unsigned event that would grant, is refused.
name: replay_relay
title: Run a relay event again
